config.tpstab.enabled.tooltip: Show the TPS card while the player list is open.
config.tpstab.showCurrentDimensionMetric: Show metrics for the dimension the player is currently in.
config.tpstab.dimensionIds.tooltip: Comma-separated dimension resource keys to keep on the card, for example minecraft:overworld, mymod:mining.
config.tpstab.updateIntervalTicks.toolti: Ticks between requests while Tab is held. 20 ticks is one second.
config.tpstab.staleDataTicks.tooltip: Age after which the last server response is marked stale.
config.tpstab.showPlaceholder.tooltip: Show a status card while waiting for the first server response.
config.tpstab.placeholderText.tooltip: Text shown while waiting for the first server response.
